title: The 1995-96 official statement that the remote viewing program never produced useful intelligence

tellings.quote: I think 96 was like this dine thing where they came out and said like, "Oh, it's uh it's not re like it's real, but like we had this program

plain: Around 1995 or 1996, according to a researcher named Chris Ramsay, the US government came out and admitted it had run a remote viewing programme, an effort to use people's minds alone to describe distant places, while saying it had not produced useful intelligence. Ramsay recalls this loosely from memory and names no source. He puts it as the government saying, in effect, that the programme existed even as it played it down.
